text: I'm not sure how comprehensive your partner's new policy is - but we have an article on our website. The title says it is for people on a B1 visa, but it applies to people on tourist visas too. Note that there are quite comprehensive and very discounted policies available to partners of Israelis who have Clalit or Meuhedet has their HMO. aic.org.il/health-insurance-for-b1-partner-visa-holders/
